description: This Java utility class provides static methods for handling field expressions within the Eclipse Ditto project, including regex wrapping, feature field parsing, and prefix management.

classes.name: FieldExpressionUtil
classes.description: Utility class for handling field expressions, including regex operations and feature field parsing.

classes.name: FieldExpressionUtil.FeatureField
classes.description: Represents a feature field with optional feature ID and property path, capable of pattern matching against field names.

methods.name: wrapExistsRegex
methods.description: Wraps a given field in a regex pattern that matches the start and end conditions.

methods.name: parseFeatureField
methods.description: Parses a field name to determine if it is a feature property field, returning an Optional of FeatureField.

methods.name: isAttributeFieldName
methods.description: Checks if a field name starts with the attributes prefix.

methods.name: stripAttributesPrefix
methods.description: Removes the attributes prefix from a field name.

methods.name: isDefinitionFieldName
methods.description: Checks if a field name starts with the definition prefix.

methods.name: addAttributesPrefix
methods.description: Adds the attributes prefix to a given field name.
